name: Iron Maiden Trap
disable: DC 28 Thievery check to disable the pressure plate
reset: The pressure plate must be reset manually.

items.name: Slam Shut
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps onto the trap's pressure plate (indicated on the map)

---
Effect The front of the iron maiden slams shut with incredible force and locks itself. The triggering creature takes 4d10+10 piercing damage and 2d6 persistent bleed damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save save; if the creature critically succeeds, they avoid the trap completely). The triggering creature is also Immobilized. The victim can end their immobilization only once a creature outside the iron maiden unlocks the device (requiring two successful DC 28 Thievery checks to disable-device dc=28) or breaks the iron maiden, after which the trapped creature must succeed at a DC 25 check to escape dc=25 the trap's spike-lined interior.

text: A pressure plate hidden on the floor before an iron maiden causes the torture device to snap shut and trap the triggering creature inside.
